verdict.rationale: Teams exposes a programmable API through Microsoft Graph (for example, posting chatMessages and the export APIs), so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on learn.microsoft.com returned 404 on every candidate. Having API reference docs is not the same as offering a downloadable spec, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
